unresolved.message: POST /api/orders/:param/expire has no guard in front of it, while the 2 other writes of OrdersController have ClientGuard, NoteGuard, ShopOpenGuard in front.
unresolved.hint: Put ClientGuard, NoteGuard, ShopOpenGuard in front of it as its siblings have, or, where it is open on purpose, mark it public (a decorator under doctor.publicDecorators, /** @flowatlas-public <why> */, or the route under doctor.publicRoutes).
The listener does more than delegate, so the chain stops at the method that registered it.
The receiver has no single class type; inject a class to make the edge visible.
